ice-sell.title: Stored goods and ice sold where a bid stands: stored null matter, methane and ice first, then the ice fields
ice-sell.note: Every route here is gated: a drain or carry opens only on goods the pilot itself stores and a fresh bid (requires.stored, requires.bid); a mine route only on a deep water-ice order at Central Nexus (300 units at its best price) and with an Ice Harvester I fitted. Drains and carries need no harvester. What miners store is sold before new ice is mined.

reserve-prism.title: Gather what the reserve lacks, then make: a loaded hold stored, gold, silicon, nickel and carbon, then steel plate and copper piping from the pilot's own stores
reserve-prism.note: Orders ENT-056, block ZERO: the reserve's short ores first (silicon, carbon, gold, nickel), each gather limited to what its field carries; P2: stored iron and copper become steel plate and piping where they lie. Gathers before crafts since 2026-11-21 (Zero): the crafts had taken the ships the short ores need.

reserve-hamal.title: Make, then gather what the reserve lacks, the short-ore fields in the other order so the division is spread
reserve-hamal.note: Orders ENT-050, block ZERO: iron and copper no more while the reserve holds them; P2: stored iron becomes steel plate. The iron gather fields left this template on 2026-11-17 23:20 UTC (Zero).
